projects.name: Transtar Migration- (Cross border payments, ACH, Wire), CT Account Automation, Repack
details: Reporting, ISO-20022 SWIFT Migration
Key Roles:
• Facilitating requirements workshops and preparing functional requirements documents.
• Working closely with product, and business stakeholders to ensure the project deliverables.
• Gathered requirements and creating user stories, use case, flow chart, & mockups.
• Performing functional testing and facilitating user acceptance testing (UAT) with business user.
• Facilitating end user training & centralized user management activity and master data management.
• Performing gaps analysis and devising a road map for enhancing applications & ensuring a smooth
implementation.
• Conducted walkthroughs, wrote test cases, and supported SIT/UAT execution.
• Responsible for daily production support activity.
Key Deliverables:
• Replaced old legacy system with existing product that has been enhanced with more business oriented
features that meets customer, regulatory & compliance bodies’ expectations, and accurate data migration.
• Delivered SWIFT solutions (MT103, MT202, and MT564) and Non-Payment corporate actions MX
messages (Seev.001/002/006/007/008/045/046) in HK, UK, US and SG; aligned with ISO 20022
standards.
• Implemented SWIFT Payment (MT103, MT202, and MT564) and cash account automation through HUB-Hadoop integration with odyssey.
